# robots.txt for Modern Age Coders Learning Platform
#
# GENERATED FILE. Edit scripts/robots-policy.json and run `npm run generate:robots`.
# Every crawler group below repeats the same Disallow list on purpose: a crawler
# reads only its own most-specific group, so a named group that said just
# "Allow: /" used to hand that crawler none of the exclusions. verify-robots.js
# fails the build if any group drifts from the policy.

# Default rules for every crawler
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /test-*.html
Disallow: /*-test.html
Disallow: /check-status
Disallow: /dummy.html
Disallow: /form-example.html

# Sitemap location
